description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Narangodapaluwa, Ja-ela D/S Division, Gampaha District - (25/0164)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title to a specific parcel of land (Parcel No. 1:55 of Block 10) in Narangodapaluwa, including details about the land owner, extent, nature of title, and encumbrances. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it involves land registration, property ownership, and title settlement matters.
